newsitem.title: LATVIA: VELDZE SEES Q2 PROFIT ON NEW PRODUCTS.
newsitem.headline: VELDZE SEES Q2 PROFIT ON NEW PRODUCTS.

text.p: Latvia's Veldze soft drink company on Monday said that it sees a second quarter profit and sales of 35,000 lats a month without tax.
"After the introduction of our new alcoholic cocktails we plan a second quarter profit on sales of 35,000 lats a month without tax," the company's chief accountant Larisa Ivanova told Reuters.
"We plan net turnover of 400,000 lats this year and expect to have a clearer future strategy ready in the second half of 1997," Ivars Ilzinsh, Veldze's manager, told Reuters.
Veldze last month introduced seven new alcoholic cocktails, seen by the company as the main focus besides soft drinks at the moment.
Only some 25 percent of Veldze's assortment are made up of soft drinks while the rest are alcoholic cocktails.
"The soft drinks' share will go up in two months time as we plan to introduce more new brands," Ilzinsh said.
"We have opted for more attractive bottles and are looking for ways of cutting expenses through cheaper concentrates," he added.
The new cocktails include rum with cola, vodka with lemon, gin and tonic and the like.
Veldze earlier reported a first quarter loss of 1,400 lats against 33,000 lats in the corresponding period a year ago.
"Our profits have to at least cover the non-material assets, the results of privatisation, to be paid up in the coming four years, or 40,000 lats a year," Ilzinsh said.
